frontend.ui: Composable design system (packages/ui), mobile-first layouts, Tailwind-compatible tokens
frontend.state_and_data: TanStack Query for server-state, lightweight local state (Zustand or Context), Zod validations
frontend.auth_ux: Supabase Auth client flows (magic link, OAuth, passwordless) with protected routes

backend_managed.database: PostgreSQL managed by Supabase with RLS-first model
backend_managed.storage: Supabase Storage buckets with policy-based access
backend_managed.realtime: Supabase Realtime for lightweight status events (claims, withdrawals, leaderboard updates)
backend_managed.server_logic: Supabase Edge Functions for sensitive workflows and external webhooks

edge_and_integrations.payments: Provider webhooks handled by Supabase Edge Functions with idempotency keys persisted in PostgreSQL
edge_and_integrations.notifications: Edge Functions + provider APIs (email/push) triggered by DB events or scheduled jobs
edge_and_integrations.auditability: Append-only ledger tables + immutable audit_logs + rule_versions snapshots

observability_and_ops.monitoring: Supabase logs, Edge Function logs, SQL query performance insights
observability_and_ops.secrets: Supabase project env vars + scoped service role usage
observability_and_ops.deployment: Single frontend deploy (Vite static hosting) + Supabase managed backend
observability_and_ops.ci_cd: Schema migration checks, SQL linting, type checks, frontend build validation

why_this_stack: Reduces custom backend overhead for MVP while preserving strong data governance.
Native Postgres + RLS aligns with compliance-by-design and data minimization.
Edge Functions isolate high-risk business logic (payments, withdrawals, reward claims).
Vite accelerates frontend iteration speed and mobile performance tuning.

monorepo_structure.packages/types: Shared domain models, ledger types, API payload contracts

security_and_compliance_foundations: Supabase Auth is the sole identity provider; all user data links to auth.uid() and sensitive actions require fresh session checks.
RLS is mandatory on all user-scoped tables (wallets, wallet_ledger, reward_orders, withdrawals, notifications, support).
Service role keys are restricted to Edge Functions and never exposed to frontend clients.
wallet_ledger is append-only: updates/deletes blocked by policy and DB trigger; all value movements use idempotency keys.
rule_versions table stores effective-dated rule payloads to guarantee traceability for probabilities/barèmes.
audit_logs captures admin actions, policy publication, manual fraud decisions, and payout reviews.
Supabase Storage uses private buckets by default for KYC/support artifacts with signed URL access windows.
Payment and withdrawal webhooks run in Edge Functions with signature verification and replay protection.
Consent evidence is persisted in legal_consents with policy version and timestamp for GDPR/CMP proof.
Public/private separation: public marketing content in frontend static assets; private financial/reward data behind RLS and authenticated queries.

what_changes: Architecture pivots from custom Node backend to Supabase-managed backend and Edge Functions.
Frontend shifts from Next.js routing model to Vite SPA with explicit route/state management.
API contracts move from REST controllers to SQL/RPC + Edge Functions orchestration.
what_becomes_simpler: MVP delivery speed improves by removing boilerplate backend services and auth plumbing.
Operational overhead decreases with managed Postgres/Auth/Storage/Realtime.
Realtime status updates for claims/withdrawals become simpler via Supabase subscriptions.
what_needs_extra_care: RLS policy correctness and policy testing become critical to prevent privilege leaks.
Edge Function idempotency and webhook signature handling must be rigorously validated.
Service role secret handling and admin action auditing require strict governance.
Ledger immutability constraints must be enforced at SQL level, not only in application code.
